meta.name: add-dial-tool
meta.description: Give chosen NanoClaw agents a real phone number as a container tool — the `dial` CLI baked into the agent image plus OneCLI credential injection for api.getdial.ai, scoped per agent, so the agents you pick can send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive verification codes from inside the sandbox. Independent of the Dial channel; idempotent; re-run to change which agents may use it. Use when the user wants agents to text, call, or run `dial …` from a chat, without wiring Dial as a messaging channel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给选中的代理配上真实电话号码，就能从聊天里发短信、打电话、收验证码。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想让你手下的代理能直接发短信、打电话或接收验证码。
copy.tagline_en: Give chosen agents a phone number for SMS, calls, and verification codes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage agents that need to text, call, or receive verification codes.

howto.what: 为选定的 NanoClaw agent 安装 Dial 容器工具：容器内的 agent 能用 `dial` 命令发短信、打 AI 语音电话、接收验证码；只有你选中的 agent 拿到密钥，其余 agent 被网关拦截（403 blocked_by_policy）。
howto.when: 当你想让 agent 在聊天里发短信、打电话或运行 `dial …`，又不想把 Dial 接成消息渠道时用它。要在宿主机 NanoClaw 仓库运行，且需先装好 OneCLI，否则第一步就停。

say.text: 给 ag-xxxx 装上 Dial 工具，让它能发短信和打电话
say.note: 接着会问你选哪些 agent，然后重建镜像并重启容器

say.text: 把所有 agent 的 Dial 权限改成只有 ag-aa、ag-bb 能用
say.note: 重跑一次即可改授权范围，其他 agent 被拦

say.text: 先只装 Dial 工具，暂时不让任何 agent 用
say.note: 输入 none：工具装上但所有 agent 都被拦截

howto.what_en: Installs Dial as a container tool for chosen NanoClaw agents: the `dial` CLI plus credential injection, so those agents can send SMS, place AI voice calls and receive verification codes. Unchosen agents are blocked at the gateway.
howto.when_en: Use when you want an agent to text, call or run `dial …` from a chat without wiring Dial as a messaging channel. Run it on the host NanoClaw repo; OneCLI must be installed first.

say_en.text: Install the Dial tool for ag-xxxx so it can send texts and calls
say_en.note: It then asks which agents, rebuilds the image and restarts containers

say_en.text: Change Dial access so only ag-aa and ag-bb may use it
say_en.note: Re-run to change who is allowed; the rest are blocked

say_en.text: Just install the Dial tool but let no agent use it yet
say_en.note: Enter none: installed, every agent blocked for now
